notes.sowing: Sow outdoors {cm:2.5} deep 1 to 4 weeks after your last frost, once the soil is at least {c:16}; supersweet types need {c:18}. Plant a block of at least four short rows, not one long row, so wind pollinates the ears. Or sow indoors in deep pots 3 to 4 weeks before planting out.
notes.care: Water deeply, above all from tasselling until the silks brown. Keep supersweet types away from other kinds, or time them to flower at least 2 weeks apart, or the kernels turn starchy. Sow a new block every 2 weeks for a longer season.
notes.harvest: Ears are ready about 3 weeks after the silks appear, when the silks are brown and dry and a pierced kernel gives milky juice. Pick in the cool of the morning and eat or chill at once.
